tonight.headline: Taylor gave you 6.7, and Friday's practice decides Tuten
body: Bad news first: Jonathan Taylor scored 6.7 against 16.6 projected Thursday night. That was 11 carries for 21 yards and 4 catches in a 26-3 loss in Houston, and the Colts' offence managed 38 rushing yards (archive; NFL.com; Yahoo). No injury was reported. Tuten is still the open question: limited Wednesday, no practice Thursday, and nobody on your bench can replace him after noon.

The rule stands. If Friday's report lists him OUT or DOUBTFUL, or he misses Friday's practice, put Rice into FLEX for Tuten before 12:00 Sunday. If he is QUESTIONABLE after a limited or full Friday, start him. KEI returns' Hutchinson (3.3) and Warren (3.2) are already in. ESPN projects 118.1 to 111.9 and gives you 53%.

case.body: KEI returns start Lawrence (18.6), Parker Washington (15.3) and Skattebo (14.5) at 15:25 in Jacksonville–New York, the same game as your Tuten and Likely (league file). A Tuten zero there decides it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten inactive at 13:55 after Rice has locked at 12:00: 17.0 projected points become zero. Friday's practice line is the trigger.
